_note: Device registry for scripts/bench.mjs. Keys are friendly device ids passed to --devices.
driver=cdp  -> driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (the Mac, via the 9222 reverse tunnel).
driver=adb  -> driven over the tunneled adb server (the phones); matched to a live serial by `match`.
`match` is a JS regex tested against marketName|modelName|model from `adb devices`; serials are NOT
hard-coded because they vary. Run `node scripts/bench.mjs devices` to see live models and fix any
mismatched `match` / `label` here. `threads` feeds the autorun ?threads= override (phones must not run
the 16-thread WASM default or pthread startup races crash them). caps.webgpuMsm records what we know:
ok | unknown | device-lost (the bench skips GPU MSM on device-lost unless --force).
